foundation.ash_born_remnant_core_v0_2B.r.why: Remnant Core Reserve: maximum Path resource increases by Proficiency Bonus in the native sheet calculation. Wisdom saves against remnant possession, ruin-terror, grief control, despair pressure and battlefield horror have Advantage; hostile destruction-as-truth pressure also qualifies. Reviewed source expressions may align already legal techniques. No resource generation, immunity, sphere access or passive damage reduction.
